title: Anxiety & Panic Disorders
text: Disorders characterized by excessive fear, anxiety, and related behavioral disturbances.

title: Behavioral Disorders
text: Disorders involving patterns of disruptive behaviors that last for at least six months and cause problems in school, at home, and in social situations.

title: Bipolar and Related Disorders
text: Disorders involving episodes of mood changes ranging from manic highs to depressive lows.

title: Depressive Disorders
text: Disorders characterized by persistent feelings of sadness, hopelessness, and loss of interest or pleasure in most activities.

title: Mood Disorders Secondary to Medical Conditions
text: Mood disturbances directly caused by a medical condition, affecting emotional and behavioral stability.

title: Obsessive Compulsive and Related Disorders
text: Disorders characterized by obsessive thoughts and repetitive behaviors aimed at reducing anxiety or distress.

title: Schizophrenia Spectrum and Other Psychotic Disorders
text: Disorders marked by delusions, hallucinations, disorganized thinking, and impaired functioning.

title: PTSD and Trauma/Stressor Related Disorders
text: Disorders triggered by exposure to traumatic or stressful events, causing distress and functional impairment.

title: Dissociative Disorders
text: Disorders involving disruptions or discontinuities in consciousness, memory, identity, or perception.

title: Somatic Symptom and Related Disorders
text: Disorders characterized by excessive focus on physical symptoms that cause significant distress and impairment.

title: Sleep-Wake Disorders
text: Disorders that involve problems with the quality, timing, and amount of sleep, affecting overall health and functioning.

title: Neurodevelopmental Disorders
text: Disorders that begin in childhood, affecting brain development and leading to developmental deficits in personal, social, academic, or occupational functioning.

title: Neurocognitive Disorders
text: Disorders characterized by a decline in cognitive function, often due to neurological or other medical conditions.

title: Personality Disorders
text: Disorders involving enduring patterns of behavior, cognition, and inner experience that deviate significantly from cultural expectations and cause distress or impairment.

title: Adjustment Disorder and Grief
text: A short-term condition that occurs when an individual struggles to cope with a significant life change or stressor, leading to emotional or behavioral symptoms.
